row.name: Flutter-Chat-App-Firebase-Authentication-Messaging-WhatsApp-Like
row.description: This Flutter project is a chat application inspired by WhatsApp. The app features a familiar interface with a functional chat page, a Local Auth Screen, and user registration using email/password or Google Account.
